items.Sentence: Wastewater first enters the WWTP at the lift station via one of two 3-inch submersible sewage pumps that pump the wastewater into a 5,000-gallon flow equalization tank.
In the equalization tank wastewater is mixed with return activated sludge under anoxic conditions to encourage denitrification.
The blended influent is then transferred via an airlift pipe into a 15,592-gallon extended aeration tank, where nitrification takes place.

Following aeration, the stabilized wastewater (mixed liquor) then flows into a 3,758-gallon circular secondary clarifier, where the mixed liquor's suspended solids are settled and recirculated back to the flow equalization tank.
The secondary treated effluent then flows over the clarifier's weirs for treatment by two dual media (sand/anthracite) gravity filters, which are stationed in parallel.

Filtered effluent then passes through an ultraviolet (UV) light disinfection system, which is comprised of two separate modules ( one is used as a lead unit and the other is available as a standby unit).
As part of the process, biosolids from the wastewater are dried in drying beds prior to disposal.
Treated wastewater effluent is then finally discharged to one of three evaporation/percolation ponds located south of the campus.
